name: Compliant Naira
notes: WrappedCBDC primary materials establish a live 1:1 Nigerian-naira stablecoin, issuer identity, reserve backing in Naira-denominated assets held with approved commercial banks, minting against Naira deposits and KYC-gated redemption. The proposed record ID is namespaced to distinguish this asset from the separate Celo/Mento cNGN symbol lineage. Full-layer promotion remains gated on exact deployment/source review and duplicate confirmation.
